nodes.label: graphify explain command
nodes.rationale: Used for focused concepts, returning a scoped subgraph rather than broad architecture docs.

nodes.label: graphify path command
nodes.rationale: Used specifically for surfacing relationships between two named entities A and B, returning a scoped subgraph rather than broad architecture docs.

nodes.label: graphify query command
nodes.rationale: Returns a scoped subgraph for a codebase question, usually much smaller than reading GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output; should be run first when graphify-out/graph.json exists.

nodes.label: graphify update command
nodes.rationale: Run after modifying code to keep the graph current; performs AST-only extraction so it incurs no API cost, making incremental updates cheap.
